title: Density functions for filtrations of graded ideals
summary: We study density functions associated with filtrations of graded ideals in standard graded domains. Extending earlier work, we develop a general theory for arbitrary filtrations and establish their fundamental properties, including existence, continuity, log-concavity, and integral representations. We show that every density function is locally uniformly approximable by piecewise polynomial density functions arising from truncated Noetherian filtrations.
